create_mbart_config_default: create an MBartConfig instance with default facebook/mbart-large-cc25 style hyperparameters
create_mbart_config_custom: create an MBartConfig with custom encoder_layers, d_model, and attention_heads values
review_mbart_config_attribute_map: review the MBartConfig attribute_map that aliases num_attention_heads to encoder_attention_heads, hidden_size to d_model, and num_hidden_layers to encoder_layers
review_mbart_config_token_ids: review the MBartConfig token ID settings for pad_token_id, bos_token_id, eos_token_id, and decoder_start_token_id
review_mbart_config_encoder_decoder_flag: review the MBartConfig flags is_encoder_decoder, use_cache, and tie_word_embeddings
